summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return for The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, reporting ongoing share repurchases for cancellation. Between March 20 and April 15, 2026, the company repurchased 733,918 to 759,056 shares per day at prices ranging from USD 6.5654 to 7.1427 per share, totaling approximately 14 million shares. The board recommends the buyback program, which reduces outstanding shares and increases EPS. The filing discloses shares repurchased but not yet canceled; no premium or fixed-price tender is involved. Investors should watch for continued execution of the buyback program and potential impact on stock liquidity.
